### GT save function and load data

```{r portal-plot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

draft <- readr::read_csv("draft_data.csv")

# save function 
gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  
  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })
  
  magick::image_read(tmp) |> 
    magick::image_trim() |> 
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |> 
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}

```

draft_prepared <- draft |>
  dplyr::filter(Pick >= 1, Pick <= 32) |>
  dplyr::mutate(combined_val = paste0(logo, "|", Pos)) |>
  dplyr::select(Year, Pick, combined_val) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = combined_val)


left_half <- draft_prepared |> dplyr::filter(Pick <= 16)
right_half <- draft_prepared |>
  dplyr::filter(Pick >= 17) |>
  dplyr::rename(Pick_b = Pick) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_b"), .cols = -Pick_b)

combined_data <- dplyr::bind_cols(left_half, right_half)

school_leaderboard <- draft |>
  dplyr::count(school_logo, sort = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(n >= 10) |>
  dplyr::rename(School = school_logo, Picks = n)

position_summary <- draft |>
  dplyr::count(Pos, sort = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::rename(Position = Pos, Total = n)

school_str <- school_leaderboard |> 
  dplyr::mutate(label = paste0(School, " (", Picks, ")")) |> 
  dplyr::pull(label) |> 
  paste(collapse = ", ")

pos_str <- position_summary |> 
  dplyr::mutate(label = paste0(Position, ": ", Total)) |> 
  dplyr::pull(label) |> 
  paste(collapse = " | ")


stack_cell <- function(x) {
  purrr::map_chr(x, ~ {
    if (is.na(.x) || .x == "NA|NA") return("")
    
    parts <- strsplit(.x, "\\|")[[1]]
    logo_url <- parts[1]
    position <- parts[2]
    
    paste0(
      "<div style='display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; line-height: 1.2;'>",
      "<img src='", logo_url, "' style='height: 25px; margin-bottom: 2px;'>",
      "<div style='font-size: 10px; color: #666; font-weight: bold;'>", position, "</div>",
      "</div>"
    )
  })
}

custom_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
      <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-football-college.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
     <div style='flex-grow:1; margin-left: 30px; margin-right: 30px'>
       <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>First Round Picks Over Past 10 NFL Drafts</span>
       <span style='font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center;'>Shows the college and position for every first round pick since 2016. The 2026 NFL Draft starts today: April 23, 2026.</span>
     </div>
     <div>
       <img src='https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTt2RPk_BBfjsBYliYsCnvxW3Di4tKZq6jP0g&s'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
   </div>
  <br>"
)


years <- as.character(2016:2025)
all_year_cols <- c(years, paste0(years, "_b"))

nfl_tbl <- combined_data |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |> 
  gt::text_transform(
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::all_of(all_year_cols)),
    fn = stack_cell
  ) |>
  gt::cols_add(diff_gap = "", .before = Pick_b) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    Pick     = "Pick",
    Pick_b   = "Pick",
    diff_gap = " "
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Pick, Pick_b)) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    .list = setNames(as.list(years), years) |>
      c(setNames(as.list(years), paste0(years, "_b")))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(custom_header)) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(source_note = gt::html(paste0("<b>Programs with 10 or more first rounders:</b> ", school_str))) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(source_note = gt::html(paste0("<b>By position:</b> ", pos_str))) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = gt::html(
      "<hr>Data via drafthistory.com | theme via {gtUtils}<br>
       <hr><b>Table by Chris at Bless your chart</b>"
    )
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size = gt::px(14),
    heading.align = "left",
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    row_group.font.size = gt::px(13),
    row_group.background.color = "#f5f5f5"
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(gt::cell_borders(
      sides = c("left", "right", "top", "bottom"),
      color = "black",
      weight = gt::px(2)  
    )),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_body(),
      gt::cells_column_labels(),
      gt::cells_row_groups()
    )
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
  style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#e0e0e0"),
  locations = gt::cells_body(columns = diff_gap)
) |>
gt::tab_style(
  style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#e0e0e0"),
  locations = gt::cells_column_labels(columns = diff_gap)
) |>
  gt::tab_style(
  style = list(
    gt::cell_text(weight = "bold", size = gt::px(16))
  ),
  locations = gt::cells_body(columns = c(Pick, Pick_b))
) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::px(550))


gt_save_crop(
  nfl_tbl,
  file = "nfl_tbl.png",
  whitespace = 40,
  bg = "white"
)


nfl_tbl
